description.value: Le Gateau Bakeshop is a Vancouver specialty bakery founded in 2010 by pastry chef Tanya Muller, focusing on custom cakes, cupcakes, and pastries for celebrations. The shop has earned recognition from Rocky Mountain Bride (Best of 2023) and a Food Network win, and has been featured in PEOPLE magazine and numerous wedding publications. Cyclists passing through East Hastings can pick up freshly baked pastries, cupcakes, and cookies from the daily in-store selection, or pre-order for pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Le Gateau Bakeshop is an active specialty bakery at the OSM address, with matching phone number (604 620 7975) and URL. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so all are null per absence-of-evidence rules. The OSM category 'Groceries' via shop=bakery is a loose fit — this is an exclusive cake/pastry boutique with no general grocery items evident.
concerns: OSM category 'Groceries' (via shop=bakery) overstates the grocery utility of this location — it is exclusively a specialty cake and pastry boutique, not a source of cycling staples.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible specialty bakery on East Hastings with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking baked goods and sweet treats.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tag shop=bakery was mapped to the Groceries category, but this business is a specialty cake and pastry boutique with no general grocery items. The category mapping is technically valid but may mislead cyclists expecting grocery staples.
